_comment: v3.1 Phase 2 query-head sweep. Encoder is FROZEN (loaded from the locked baseline, SHA-asserted) so every arm shares one encoder — no stage-A re-pretrain, no per-arm confound. Only the QueryToBall head is trained (stage B). Norm is only swept for archs that use it (qh2/qh3); qh0/qh1/qh4 ignore it so they get one cell each.
